fields.period: K-line tab/period that owns the mark, such as 1d or 1w; defaults to the active tab when created
fields.points: Exact candle times and evidence-bound prices; see typeDefinitions for anchor counts. Never snap a missing date to another candle.
fields.text: string (required for text/callout; both render in a bubble with an arrow anchored at the point, optional for price lines)
fields.offsetX: number of canvas pixels (optional for text/callout)
fields.offsetY: number of canvas pixels (optional for text/callout)
fields.levels: 1..16 distinct numbers in [-10,10]; fib-timezone allows [-144,144]. Retracement/channel default [0,.236,.382,.5,.618,.786,1].
fields.levelColors: Optional array of 1..16 hex colors in level order; explicit color sets all levels otherwise native ratio palette applies.
fields.deviation: 0.1..5; regression residual standard deviation multiplier, default 2
fields.emoji: 1..16 characters for type emoji; plain canvas text, never HTML

semantics.parallel-channel: First two anchors form a baseline; third sets a parallel boundary. Median is dotted.
semantics.disjoint-channel: Two separate boundaries: points[0:2] and points[2:4]. No forced parallelism.
semantics.regression-channel: OLS of actual candle closes between anchor times, bands = +/- deviation * residual population standard deviation.
semantics.pitchfork: Median from A to midpoint(B,C); outer rays through B,C. Schiff moves A halfway toward B in price; modified Schiff also moves halfway in bar index.
semantics.fib-retracement: Level r price = B.price + r*(A.price-B.price); 0 at B and 1 at A.
semantics.fib-extension: Level r price = C.price + r*(B.price-A.price). Projections, not price predictions.
semantics.fib-channel: Baseline A->B, offset from C at its bar index; level r multiplies that offset.
semantics.fib-timezone: Verticals at A.index + r*(B.index-A.index), default r=0,1,2,3,5,8. Never map nontrading dates.
semantics.rotated-rectangle: A,B define first edge; C determines perpendicular width in canvas coordinates.
semantics.circle: A=center, B=radius endpoint in canvas coordinates; like ellipse/rotation this is viewport-dependent geometry, not an invariant price angle.
semantics.curve: Quadratic Bezier A->C with B as control point; brush/highlighter connect supplied points, no invented interpolation evidence.
semantics.long-position: A=entry, B=stop, C=target/end time; require stop<entry<target. Scenario only, no order execution.
semantics.short-position: A=entry, B=stop, C=target/end time; require target<entry<stop. Scenario only, no order execution.
semantics.measurement: Price change and percent use anchor prices; date measures count actual candle intervals and elapsed calendar days separately.

unsupportedTypes.gann: Requires explicit price-per-bar scale and a dedicated implementation; not approximated by screen angles.
unsupportedTypes.volume-profile: Use the volume_profile business component with real price-volume distribution; candle OHLCV is not volume-at-price.
unsupportedTypes.forecast-candles: No invented future candles, bar-pattern copies, or position forecasts presented as observed prices.
unsupportedTypes.image-post-idea: External media/posts require an audited content source and separate content component.
unsupportedTypes.other-fib-tools: Fib circles/arcs/wedges, speed-resistance fan and trend-time are not aliases for the supported retracement/fan/timezone.
unsupportedTypes.other-drawings: Trend-angle, flat-top/bottom channel, arcs and cubic/double curves are not implemented; circle/rotation use viewport-dependent screen geometry only.
